cues: On the galvanised sheet, zinc is more reactive than iron.
Zinc is the anode and corrodes, slowly, while the iron is the cathode and stays safe.
On the tinned sheet, iron is more reactive than tin.
Now iron is the anode, and the large tin surface is the cathode, so the exposed iron rusts even faster than bare iron would.
